meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 做出一份可点击、能分支跳转、带演讲备注的演示幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要把想法或网页做成能上台演示的交互幻灯片。
copy.tagline_en: Build a clickable presentation deck with branching and speaker notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn ideas or a webpage into an interactive deck to present.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为你编写 HyperFrames 幻灯片(演示或 pitch deck):声明幻灯片场景、写入 JSON island,产出可导航的 deck,带分支、热点、演讲者备注与校验,而不是渲染成 MP4。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做幻灯片、演示或 pitch deck,或要把现有页面转成 deck 时触发;若只是相邻说法(如「presentation」),它会先确认要不要做成 HyperFrames slideshow。

say.text: 帮我把这份内容做成一套 HyperFrames 幻灯片
say.note: 它会先向你确认意图再开始编写

say.text: 把这个页面转换成可导航的幻灯片
say.note: 会尽量保留原页面的视觉与交互

say.text: 给当前幻灯片加一个热点,点开跳转到分支序列

howto.what_en: Claude authors a HyperFrames slideshow: it declares slide scenes and writes a JSON island, producing a navigable deck with branching, hotspots, presenter notes and validation — not a rendered MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, presentation or pitch deck, or to convert an existing page into a deck; on adjacent wording it confirms the intent first.

say_en.text: Turn this content into a HyperFrames slideshow
Convert this page into a navigable slideshow
say_en.note: Keeps the source page's visuals and interactions

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on this slide that jumps to a branch sequence
say_en.note: Target must match a slideSequences id
